findings.guidelineQuote: Joining date parts by hand, such as getDate and getMonth, is a finding.
findings.title: Date parts joined by hand
findings.body: The receipt joins day and month by hand; use formatDate.

findings.guidelineQuote: A date shown to a person is formatted by formatDate from the shared formatter.
findings.title: Date formatted without the shared formatter
findings.body: The order date is formatted with toISOString instead of formatDate.
